blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Four Department of Health in Central Visayas (DOH-7) hospitals recorded a 26.8 percent year-on-year increase in respiratory consultations from July to September 2026, amid continuing poor air quality in Metro Cebu.
